title: The Voice of the News
goal: Report facts the way a newspaper does, without naming who says or does them.

items: I can report a fact impersonally with *se estima que* and *se espera que*.
I can say where information comes from with *según fuentes oficiales*.
I can tell an impersonal sentence from one with a named person.
